recommendation: Keep the source fix. It restores the intended local interaction name without reopening the 2015 decision to retain conditional delete support with optionality guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-7927 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked to remove conditional delete support, but the approved change was to keep conditional delete and add language explaining that transactions and conditional operations are complex and not expected on every server.
initial_application: The issue was applied through the shared FHIR-7928 implementation commit 51d2438efb, which added the optionality/complexity note to conditional update, conditional delete, conditional create, and transaction sections. Jira comments on FHIR-7927 point to the same resolution as FHIR-7928 and say the change was already applied.
additional_context: The active source is source/http.html, linked from source/documentation.html as the RESTful API page. Later commit 8d445f4fd52 changed the conditional delete section's unsupported-interaction sentence from conditional delete to conditional update while standardizing error/OperationOutcome wording. FHIR-7926 and FHIR-7928 are the same conditional-operation issue family.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html in the conditional delete section from "Servers that don't support the conditional update" to "Servers that don't support the conditional delete". The change preserves the resolved decision to retain conditional delete as an optional complex interaction.
source_changes: source/http.html: in the conditional delete section, changed the unsupported-interaction sentence to name conditional delete instead of conditional update.
